description: This Dart source file defines an API client service class for making HTTP requests with authentication, handling API exceptions, and managing tokens stored in shared preferences.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API-related errors, including an error message and optional status code.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Service class for handling API requests with support for authentication tokens, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE methods and token management.

methods.name: ApiException
methods.description: Constructor for creating an ApiException with a message and optional status code.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overridden method to produce a string representation of the exception, including status code if present.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API client with a base URL and SharedPreferences instance.

methods.name: authToken
methods.description: Getter to retrieve the stored authentication token.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Method to set and store a new authentication token.

methods.name: clearAuthToken
methods.description: Method to remove the stored authentication token.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Private getter that constructs HTTP headers, including Authorization if a token is present.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified endpoint.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a data payload to the specified endpoint.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with a data payload to the specified endpoint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified endpoint.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Internal method to process HTTP responses, decoding JSON on success, throwing exceptions on failure.
